title: Array42: a native Zig port of Free42 with array types, as an MCP server
description: Array42 is a native Zig port of Free42, Thomas Okken's HP-42S simulator, with array types in the style of DB48X, exposed as an MCP server and a Claude Code skill. Free42 is (C) 2004-2024 Thomas Okken; CREDITS lists everyone Free42 credits.
